verses.geez: እስመ፡ አነሂኬ፡ መዋቲ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዕሩይ፡ አምሳለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ወወልደ፡ ምድራዊ፡ ዘተልሕኰ፡ ቅድመ፡ ወውስተ፡ ከርሠ፡ እምየ፡ ተገለፍኩ፡ ሥጋ።
verses.translation: I myself also am a mortal man, like to all, and the offspring of him that was first made of the earth,

translations.lxx: I myself also am a mortal man, like to all, and the offspring of him that was first made of the earth,
translations.ron: Sunt şi eu om muritor asemenea tuturor şi coborând din neamul celui dintâi om zidit din pământ.
translations.grk: Εἰμι μὲν κᾀγὼ θνητὸς ἄνθρωπος, ἶσος ἅπασι, καὶ γηγενοῦς ἀπόγονος πρωτοπλάστου.

verses.geez: ወነበርኩ፡ ርጉአ፡ በደም፡ ዓሠርተ፡ አውራኅ፡ እምዘርአ፡ ብእሲ፡ ወፍትወተ፡ ንዋም፡ በሩካቤ።
verses.translation: and in my mother's womb was fashioned to be flesh in the time of ten months, being compacted in blood, of the seed of man, and the pleasure that came with sleep.

translations.lxx: and in my mother's womb was fashioned to be flesh in the time of ten months, being compacted in blood, of the seed of man, and the pleasure that came with sleep.
translations.ron: Şi am fost înfiripat, cu trupul, în pântecele mamei mele, închegându-mă din sânge, vreme de zece luni, din sămânţă bărbătească şi în ceasul somnului odihnitor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐν κοιλίᾳ μητρὸς ἐγλύφην σὰρξ δεκαμηνιαίῳ χρόνῳ, παγεὶς ἐν αἵματι ἐκ σπέρματος ἀνδρὸς καὶ ἡδονῆς ὕπνῳ συνελθούσης.

verses.geez: ወአነሂ፡ ነሣእኩ፡ ነፍሰ፡ ሶበ፡ ተወለድኩ፡ ከመ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወወረድኩ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ መምሰሊተ፡ ሕማምየ፡ ወቀዳሚተ፡ ቃል፡ አውጻእኩ፡ ብካየ።
verses.translation: And when I was born, I drew in the common air, and fell upon the earth, which is of like nature, and the first voice which I uttered was crying, as all others do.

translations.lxx: And when I was born, I drew in the common air, and fell upon the earth, which is of like nature, and the first voice which I uttered was crying, as all others do.
translations.ron: Şi după ce m-am născut, am respirat aerul obştesc şi pe pământul obşteştii pătimiri am căzut şi eu, şi glasul meu dintâi, la fel ca la toată lumea, a fost plânsul meu.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγὼ δὲ γενόμενος ἔσπασα τὸν κοινὸν ἀέρα, καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν ὁμοιοπαθῆ κατέπεσον γῆν, πρώτην φωνὴν τὴν ὁμοίαν πᾶσιν ἶσα κλαίων.

verses.geez: ወአጽርቅት፡ ልህቁ፡ ወበትካዝ፡ እስመ፡ አልቦ፡ እምነገሥት፡ ዘካልአ፡ ኮነ፡ ጥንተ፡ ልደቱ።
verses.translation: I was nursed in swaddling clothes, and that with cares.

translations.lxx: I was nursed in swaddling clothes, and that with cares.
translations.ron: Am fost înfăşat în scutece şi am dat părinţilor grijă şi bătaie de cap.
translations.grk: Ἐν σπαργάνοις ἀνετράφην, καὶ ἐν φροντίσιν.

verses.geez: ወአሐቲ፡ ይእቲ፡ ምጽአቱ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ውስተ፡ ዓለም፡ ወጸአተ፡ ኵሉ፡ በዕሩይ።
verses.translation: For there is no king that had any other beginning of birth.

translations.lxx: For there is no king that had any other beginning of birth.
translations.ron: Şi nici un rege n-a început altfel, când s-a născut.
translations.grk: Οὐδεὶς γὰρ βασιλεὺς ἑτέραν ἔσχε γενέσεως ἀρχήν.

verses.geez: ወበእንተዝ፡ ጸለይኩ፡ ወአእምሮ፡ ተውህበኒ፡ ሊተ፡ አስተብቋዕኩ፡ ወመጽአኒ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ጥበብ።
verses.translation: For all men have one entrance into life, and the like going out.

translations.lxx: For all men have one entrance into life, and the like going out.
translations.ron: Că toţi intră în viaţă în acelaşi fel şi ies iarăşi la fel.
translations.grk: Μία δὲ πάντων εἴσοδος εἰς τὸν βίον, ἔξοδός τε ἴση.

verses.geez: ወአክበርክዋ፡ እምኵናነ፡ መንግሥት፡ ወመናብርት፡ ወለብዕልኒ፡ ከመ፡ ወኢምንት፡ ረሰይክዋ፡ በመድሎታ።
verses.translation: Wherefore I prayed, and understanding was given me: I called upon God, and the spirit of wisdom came to me.

translations.lxx: Wherefore I prayed, and understanding was given me: I called upon God, and the spirit of wisdom came to me.
translations.ron: Pentru aceea m-am rugat şi mi s-a dat înţelepciune, am chemat, şi duhul cuminţeniei a coborât în mine.
translations.grk: Διὰ τοῦτο ηὐξάμην, καὶ φρόνησις ἐδόθη μοι, ἐπεκαλεσάμην, καὶ ἦλθέ μοι πνεῦμα σοφίας.

verses.geez: ወኢያስተማሰልክዋ፡ በእብነ፡ ባሕርይ፡ ዘሤጥ፡ አልቦቱ፡ እስመ፡ ኵሉ፡ ወርቅ፡ በቅድመ፡ ገጻ፡ ከመ፡ ኆፃ፡ ኅዳጥ፡ ወከመ፡ ዕቡር፡ ይመስል፡ ብሩር፡ በቅድሜሃ።
verses.translation: I preferred her before sceptres and thrones, and esteemed riches nothing in comparison of her.

translations.lxx: I preferred her before sceptres and thrones, and esteemed riches nothing in comparison of her.
translations.ron: Am ţinut la ea mai mult decât la sceptre şi decât la tronuri şi am socotit bogăţiile deşarte faţă de ea.
translations.grk: Προέκρινα αὐτὴν σκήπτρων καὶ θρόνων, καὶ πλοῦτον οὐδὲν ἡγησάμην ἐν συγκρίσει αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ወእምነ፡ ሕይወት፡ ወእምሥነ፡ ላህያ፡ አፍቀርክዋ፡ ፈድፋደ፡ ወአብደርክዋ፡ ህየንተ፡ ብርሃን፡ ትኩነኒ፡ እስመ፡ ፀዳለ፡ ብርሃን፡ ዘእምውስቴታ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ኢይትጋባእ፡ ወኢይነውም።
verses.translation: Neither compared I unto her any precious stone, because all gold in respect of her is as a little sand, and silver shall be counted as clay before her.

translations.lxx: Neither compared I unto her any precious stone, because all gold in respect of her is as a little sand, and silver shall be counted as clay before her.
translations.ron: N-am pus alături cu ea nici pietrele cele mai scumpe, fiindcă tot aurul din lume pe lângă ea nu e decât nisip, iar argintul, înaintea ei, mi se pare noroi.
translations.grk: Οὐδὲ ὁμοίωσα αὐτῇ λίθον ἀτίμητον, ὅτι ὁ πᾶς χρυσὸς ἐν ὄψει αὐτῆς ψάμμος ὀλίγη, καὶ ὡς πηλὸς λογισθήσεται ἄργυρος ἐναντίον αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ወመጽአኒ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሠናያት፡ ምስሌሃ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ወዘአልቦ፡ ኊልቊ፡ ብዕል፡ ውስተ፡ እዴሃ።
verses.translation: I loved her above health and beauty, and chose to have her instead of light: for the light that cometh from her never goeth out.

translations.lxx: I loved her above health and beauty, and chose to have her instead of light: for the light that cometh from her never goeth out.
translations.ron: Am preţuit înţelepciunea mai mult decât sănătatea şi frumuseţea; am pus-o chiar înaintea luminii, fiindcă strălucirea ei nu se stinge niciodată.
translations.grk: Ὑπὲρ ὑγίειαν καὶ εὐμορφίαν ἠγάπησα αὐτὴν, καὶ προειλόμην αὐτὴν ἀντὶ φωτὸς ἔχειν, ὅτι ἀκοίμητον τὸ ἐκ ταύτης φέγγος.

verses.geez: ወተፈሣሕኩ፡ በኵሉ፡ እስመ፡ መኰንንቶሙ፡ ይእቲ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወኢያእመርኩ፡ ከመ፡ ገባሪቱ፡ ይእቲ፡ ለዝ፡ ኵሉ።
verses.translation: All good things together came to me with her, and innumerable riches in her hands.

translations.lxx: All good things together came to me with her, and innumerable riches in her hands.
translations.ron: Împreună cu ea mi-au venit toate bunătăţile, căci în mâinile ei sunt bogăţii nenumărate.
translations.grk: Ἦλθε δέ μοι τὰ ἀγαθὰ ὁμοῦ πάντα μετʼ αὐτῆς, καὶ ἀναρίθμητος πλοῦτος ἐν χερσὶν αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ወሶበ፡ አእመርኩ፡ ዘንተ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ እከይ፡ ወዘእንበለ፡ ቅንአት፡ እሁበ፡ ኪያሃ፡ ወብዕላ፡ ኢየኃብእ።
verses.translation: And I rejoiced in them all, because wisdom goeth before them: and I knew not that she was the mother of them.

translations.lxx: And I rejoiced in them all, because wisdom goeth before them: and I knew not that she was the mother of them.
translations.ron: Şi m-am bucurat de toate acestea, căci înţelepciunea le aduce cu sine. Totuşi eu nu ştiam că ea este născătoarea lor.
translations.grk: Εὐφράνθην δὲ ἐπὶ πάντων, ὅτι αὐτῶν ἡγεῖται σοφία, ἠγνόουν δὲ αὐτὴν γενέτιν εἶναι τούτων.

verses.geez: ወኢየኃልቅ፡ መዝገበ፡ ይእቲ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ወእለ፡ አጥረይዋ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በጽሑ፡ ወተዓረኩ፡ በእንተ፡ ምግባረ፡ ተግሣፅ፡ እንተ፡ ትከሥት፡ ሀብተ።
verses.translation: I learned diligently, and do communicate her liberally: I do not hide her riches.

translations.lxx: I learned diligently, and do communicate her liberally: I do not hide her riches.
translations.ron: Am învăţat-o fără viclenie, o împărtăşesc fără părere de rău şi nu ascund comorile ei.
translations.grk: Ἀδόλως τε ἔμαθον, ἀφθόνως τε μεταδίδωμι, τὸν πλοῦτον αὐτῆς οὐκ ἀποκρύπτομαι.

verses.geez: ወሊተኒ፡ ወሀበኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እንግር፡ ዘይትፈተው፡ ወአሐሊ፡ ሕሊና፡ ዘይደሉ፡ ለዘይትወሀቦ፡ እስመ፡ ውእቱ፡ መርሕ፡ ውስተ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወመርትዐ፡ ጠበብት።
verses.translation: For she is a treasure unto men that never faileth: which they that use become the friends of God, being commended for the gifts that come from learning.

translations.lxx: For she is a treasure unto men that never faileth: which they that use become the friends of God, being commended for the gifts that come from learning.
translations.ron: Ea este pentru oameni comoară nesfârşită; cei care se folosesc de ea se fac prietenii lui Dumnezeu, pentru darurile agonisite de învăţătură.
translations.grk: Ἀνεκλιπὴς γὰρ θησαυρός ἐστιν ἀνθρώποις, ὃν οἱ χρησάμενοι πρὸς Θεὸν ἐστείλαντο φιλίαν, διὰ τὰς ἐκ παιδείας δωρεὰς συσταθέντες.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ውስተ፡ እዴሁ፡ ንሕነ፡ ኵልነ፡ ወነገርነኒ፡ ኵሉ፡ ጠይቆ፡ ወአእምሮ፡ ምግባራት።
verses.translation: God hath granted me to speak as I would, and to conceive as is meet for the things that are given me: because it is he that leadeth unto wisdom, and directeth the wise.

translations.lxx: God hath granted me to speak as I would, and to conceive as is meet for the things that are given me: because it is he that leadeth unto wisdom, and directeth the wise.
translations.ron: Iar mie să-mi dăruiască Dumnezeu să grăiesc precum gândesc şi să cuget în chip vrednic despre darurile Sale, căci El este povăţuitorul înţelepciunii şi îndreptătorul înţelepţilor.
translations.grk: Ἐμοὶ δὲ δῴη ὁ Θεὸς εἰπεῖν κατὰ γνώμην, καὶ ἐνθυμηθῆναι ἀξίως τῶν δεδομένων, ὅτι αὐτὸς καὶ τῆς σοφίας ὁδηγός ἐστι, καὶ τῶν σοφῶν διορθωτής.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወሀበኒ፡ ቃለ፡ አእምሮ፡ ህልወ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ሐስዎ፡ ከመ፡ አእምር፡ ሥርዓተ፡ ቁመተ፡ ዓለም፡ ወምግባረ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወወርኅ፡ ወከዋክብት።
verses.translation: For in his hand are both we and our words; all wisdom also, and knowledge of workmanship.

translations.lxx: For in his hand are both we and our words; all wisdom also, and knowledge of workmanship.
translations.ron: Că în mâna Lui suntem şi noi şi cuvintele noastre şi toată înţelepciunea şi ştiinţa lucrurilor.
translations.grk: Ἐν γὰρ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡμεῖς καὶ οἱ λόγοι ἡμῶν, πᾶσά τε φρόνησις καὶ ἐργατειῶν ἐπιστήμη.

verses.geez: ጥንተ፡ ወተፍጸመ፡ ወማእከለ፡ መዋዕል፡ ወሙያጤ፡ መዋዕል፡ ወተፋልሶ፡ ጊዜያት።
verses.translation: For he hath given me certain knowledge of the things that are, namely, to know how the world was made, and the operation of the elements:

translations.lxx: For he hath given me certain knowledge of the things that are, namely, to know how the world was made, and the operation of the elements:
translations.ron: El mi-a dat cunoştinţa cea adevărată despre cele ce sunt, ca să ştiu întocmirea lumii şi lucrarea stihiilor.
translations.grk: Αὐτὸς γάρ μοι ἔδωκε τῶν ὄντων γνῶσιν ἀψευδῆ, εἰδέναι σύστασιν κόσμου καὶ ἐνέργειαν στοιχείων,

verses.geez: ወዑደተ፡ ዓመታት፡ ወንብረተ፡ ከዋክብት።
verses.translation: the beginning, ending, and midst of the times: the alterations of the turning of the sun, and change of seasons:

translations.lxx: the beginning, ending, and midst of the times: the alterations of the turning of the sun, and change of seasons:
translations.ron: Începutul şi sfârşitul şi mijlocul vremurilor, întoarcerile anotimpurilor şi prefacerile văzduhului,
translations.grk: ἀρχὴν καὶ τέλος καὶ μεσότητα χρόνων, τροπῶν ἀλλαγὰς καὶ μεταβολὰς καιρῶν,

verses.geez: ወጠባይዐ፡ እንስሳ፡ ወነፍሳተ፡ አራዊት፡ ወኃይለ፡ ነፋሳት፡ ወሕሊና፡ ሰብእ፡ ወፈሊጠ፡ ዕፅው፡ ወኃይለ፡ ምግባርሰ፡ አሥራው።
verses.translation: the circuits of years, and positions of stars:

translations.lxx: the circuits of years, and positions of stars:
translations.ron: Cursurile anilor şi rânduiala stelelor,
translations.grk: ἐνιαυτῶν κύκλους καὶ ἀστέρων θέσεις,

verses.geez: አእመርኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘኅቡእ፡ ወዘከሡት፡ እስመ፡ ኬንያሁ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ግበር፡ መሀረኒ፡ ጥበበ።
verses.translation: the natures of living creatures, and the furies of wild beasts: the violence of winds, and the reasonings of men: the diversities of plants, and the virtues of roots:

translations.lxx: the natures of living creatures, and the furies of wild beasts: the violence of winds, and the reasonings of men: the diversities of plants, and the virtues of roots:
translations.ron: Firea dobitoacelor şi apucăturile fiarelor, puterea duhurilor şi gândurile oamenilor, feluritele neamuri ale plantelor şi însuşirile rădăcinilor.
translations.grk: φύσεις ζώων καὶ θυμοὺς θηρίων, πνευμάτων βίας καὶ διαλογισμοὺς ἀνθρώπων, διαφορὰς φυτῶν καὶ δυνάμεις ῥιζῶν,

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ቦቱ፡ ውእቱ፡ መንፈሰ፡ አእምሮ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ብሑተ፡ ልደት፡ እንዘ፡ አሐዱ፡ ክፍሉ፡ ውስተ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ክፍል።
verses.translation: and all such things as are either secret or manifest, them I know.

translations.lxx: and all such things as are either secret or manifest, them I know.
translations.ron: Toate cele ascunse şi cele arătate le-am cunoscut, fiindcă înţelepciunea, lucrătoarea tuturor, mi-a dat învăţătură.
translations.grk: ὅσα τέ ἐστι κρυπτὰ καὶ ἐμφανῆ ἔγνων.

verses.geez: ወጢን፡ ዘፍጡን፡ ነሶሳው፡ ወሠናይ፡ ቃሉ፡ ወጠቢብ፡ ዘአልቦቱ፡ ርስሐት፡ ዘኢይፃሙ፡ ህልው፡ አንተ፡ አልቦቱ፡ ጽንፍ፡ መፍቀሬ፡ ኂሩት፡ በሊኅ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ዘይከልኦ፡ ዘያሤኒ።
verses.translation: For wisdom, which is the worker of all things, taught me: for in her is an understanding spirit, holy, one only, manifold, subtil, lively, clear, undefiled, plain, not subject to hurt, loving the thing that is good, quick, which cannot be letted, ready to do good,

translations.lxx: For wisdom, which is the worker of all things, taught me: for in her is an understanding spirit, holy, one only, manifold, subtil, lively, clear, undefiled, plain, not subject to hurt, loving the thing that is good, quick, which cannot be letted, ready to do good,
translations.ron: Într-adevăr, în ea se află un duh de înţelegere, sfânt, fără pereche, cu multe laturi, nepământesc, ager, pătrunzător, neîntinat, preaînţelept, fără de patimă, iubitor de bine, ascuţit, neoprit, binefăcător,
translations.grk: Ἡ γὰρ πάντων τεχνίτις ἐδίδαξέ με σοφία· ἔστι γὰρ ἐν αὐτῇ πνεῦμα νοερὸν, ἅγιον, μονογενὲς, πολυμερὲς, λεπτὸν, εὐκίνητον, τρανὸν, ἀμόλυντον, σαφὲς, ἀπήμαντον, φιλάγαθον, ὀξὺ, ἀκώλυτον, εὐεργετικὸν,

verses.geez: መፍቀሬ፡ ሰብእ፡ ስንዓሃ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ማእምር፡ ዘበአማን፡ ዕጉሥ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ታካዘ፡ ከሃሌ፡ ኵሉ፡ ወሐዋፄ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘይበውእ፡ ውስተ፡ መናፍስት፡ ንጹሐት፡ ለባውያተ፡ ወቀጢናት።
verses.translation: kind to man, stedfast, sure, free from care, having all power, overseeing all things, and going through all understanding, pure, and most subtil, spirits.

translations.lxx: kind to man, stedfast, sure, free from care, having all power, overseeing all things, and going through all understanding, pure, and most subtil, spirits.
translations.ron: Iubitor de oameni, neclintit, temeinic, netulburat, atotputernic, atotveghetor şi răzbătând prin toate duhurile isteţe, curate şi oricât de subţiri.
translations.grk: φιλάνθρωπον, βέβαιον, ἀσφαλὲς, ἀμέριμνον, παντοδύναμον, πανεπίσκοπον, καὶ διὰ πάντων χωροῦν πνευμάτων νοερῶν, καθαρῶν, λεπτοτάτων.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ሑሳታ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ይፈጥን፡ እምኵሉ፡ ሑሰት፡ ትሰፍሕ፡ ወታንሶሱ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ወተሐውር፡ እንተ፡ ዲበ፡ ኵሉ፡ በእንተ፡ ጽርየተ፡ ንጽሓ።
verses.translation: For wisdom is more moving than any motion: she passeth and goeth through all things by reason of her pureness.

translations.lxx: For wisdom is more moving than any motion: she passeth and goeth through all things by reason of her pureness.
translations.ron: Pentru că înţelepciunea este mai sprintenă decât orice mişcare, ea pătrunde şi îşi face loc pretutindeni prin curăţia ei.
translations.grk: Πάσης γὰρ κινήσεως κινητικώτερον σοφία, διήκει δὲ καὶ χωρεῖ διὰ πάντων διὰ τὴν καθαρότητα.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ላህበ፡ ኃይለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይእቲ፡ ወስብሐተ፡ አኃዜ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘዕዉቅ፡ አርአያሁ፡ ስቡሕ፡ ወንጹሕ፡ በእንተዝ፡ ምንትኒ፡ አልቦ፡ ርኵስ፡ ዘይዳደቅ።
verses.translation: For she is the breath of the power of God, and a pure influence flowing from the glory of the Almighty: therefore can no defiled thing fall into her.

translations.lxx: For she is the breath of the power of God, and a pure influence flowing from the glory of the Almighty: therefore can no defiled thing fall into her.
translations.ron: Ea este suflul puterii lui Dumnezeu, ea este curata revărsare a slavei Celui Atotputernic, astfel că nimic nu poate s-o mânjească.
translations.grk: Ἀτμὶς γάρ ἐστι τῆς τοῦ Θεοῦ δυνάμεως. καὶ ἀπόῤῥοια τῆς τοῦ παντοκράτορος δόξης εἰλικρινής· διὰ τοῦτο οὐδὲν μεμιαμμένον εἰς αὐτὴν παρεμπίπτει.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ዋካ፡ ብርሃን፡ ይእቲ፡ ዘቀዳማዊ፡ ወመጽሔተ፡ ግብረ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይእቲ፡ እንተ፡ ኢትዴምን።
verses.translation: For she is the brightness of the everlasting light, the unspotted mirror of the power of God, and the image of his goodness.

translations.lxx: For she is the brightness of the everlasting light, the unspotted mirror of the power of God, and the image of his goodness.
translations.ron: Ea este strălucirea luminii celei veşnice şi oglinda fără pată a lucrării lui Dumnezeu şi chipul bunătăţii Sale.
translations.grk: Ἀπαύγασμα γάρ ἐστι φωτὸς ἀϊδίου, καὶ ἔσοπτρον ἀκηλίδωτον τῆς τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐνεργείας, καὶ εἰκὼν τῆς ἀγαθότητος αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወአርአያ፡ ኂሩቱ፡ እንዘ፡ አሐቲ፡ ይእቲ፡ ኵሎ፡ ትክል፡ ወእንዘ፡ በርስዕ፡ ሀለወት፡ ኵሎ፡ ትሔድስ፡ ወትትፋለስ፡ ውስተ፡ ነፍሳተ፡ ጻድቃን፡ እምትውልድ፡ ውስተ፡ ትውልድ።
verses.translation: And being but one, she can do all things: and remaining in herself, she maketh all things new: and in all ages entering into holy souls, she maketh them friends of God, and prophets.

translations.lxx: And being but one, she can do all things: and remaining in herself, she maketh all things new: and in all ages entering into holy souls, she maketh them friends of God, and prophets.
translations.ron: Fiindcă este una, toate le poate, şi rămânând una cu sine însăşi, ea toate le înnoieşte, şi răspândindu-se, prin veacuri, în sufletele sfinte, ea întocmeşte din ele prieteni ai lui Dumnezeu şi prooroci.
translations.grk: Μία δὲ οὖσα πάντα δύναται, καὶ μένουσα ἐν αὑτῇ τὰ πάντα καινίζει, καὶ κατὰ γενεὰς εἰς ψυχὰς ὁσίας μεταβαίνουσα, φίλους Θεοῦ καὶ προφήτας κατασκευάζει.

verses.geez: ወትሬስዮሙ፡ አዕርክተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወነቢያቲሁ፡ እስመ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘያፈቅር፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ምስለ፡ ጥበብ፡ ዘየኃድር።
verses.translation: For God loveth none but him that dwelleth with wisdom.

translations.lxx: For God loveth none but him that dwelleth with wisdom.
translations.ron: Cu adevărat Dumnezeu nimic nu iubeşte, fără numai pe cel ce petrece întru înţelepciune.
translations.grk: Οὐθὲν γὰρ ἀγαπᾷ ὁ Θεὸς, εἰ μὴ τὸν σοφίᾳ συνοικοῦντα.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ትልሂ፡ ይእቲ፡ በሥነ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወትፈደፍድ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኅብረ፡ ከዋክብት።
verses.translation: For she is more beautiful than the sun, and above all the order of stars: being compared with the light, she is found before it.

translations.lxx: For she is more beautiful than the sun, and above all the order of stars: being compared with the light, she is found before it.
translations.ron: Ea este mai frumoasă decât soarele şi decât toată orânduirea stelelor; dacă o pui alături cu lumina, înţelepciunea o întrece.
translations.grk: Ἔστι γὰρ αὕτη εὐπρεπεστέρα ἡλίου, καὶ ὑπὲρ πᾶσαν ἄστρων θέσιν, φωτὶ συγκρινομένη εὑρίσκεται προτέρα.

verses.geez: ወሶበ፡ ተደለወት፡ ምስለ፡ ብርሃን፡ ትትረከብ፡ እምቅድሜሁ፡ እስመ፡ ለብርሃን፡ ደዌልጦ፡ ሌሊት፡ ወለጥበብሰ፡ ኢይትኄየላ፡ ምንትኒ፡ እኩይ።
verses.translation: For after this cometh night: but vice shall not prevail against wisdom.

translations.lxx: For after this cometh night: but vice shall not prevail against wisdom.
translations.ron: Fiindcă după lumină urmează noaptea, pe când înţelepciunea rămâne nebiruită în faţa răutăţii.
translations.grk: Τοῦτο μὲν γὰρ διαδέχεται νὺξ, σοφίας δὲ οὐκ ἀντισχύει κακία.

note: Solomon speaks of Wisdom: 'She is a breath of the power of God, a pure emanation of the glory of the Almighty.' The highest personification of Wisdom in Jewish literature. She is 'an image of his goodness' — language that shaped Christian Logos theology.
